def: to hate (as one of an opposite tribe or party); hence to be hostile

words.word: then i will be an enemy

occurrences.text: But if thou shalt indeed obey his voice, and do all that I speak; then I will be an enemy unto thine enemies, and an adversary unto thine adversaries.
